faq.q1: How do I choose the best Moroccan cosmetics manufacturer?
faq.a1: Look for in-house production, ISO and GMP oriented quality, and export experience. We manufacture in Marrakesh with 100% authentic Moroccan ingredients, bulk supply, and private label support.
faq.q2: Do you offer private label and custom branding?
faq.a2: Yes. Formula, packaging, and brand identity can be customized. Products are prepared to approved quality standards for international export.
faq.q3: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faq.a3: Wholesale MOQ starts from 50 pieces, depending on product type, packaging, and labeling. Share your mix when you request a quote.
faq.a4: Yes. We export with documentation, international shipping, and packaging adapted to distributors in Europe, the Americas, Africa, and the Gulf.
faq.q5: Can I request samples before a bulk order?
faq.a5: Sample requests are discussed with your catalog inquiry. They help approve texture, scent, and packaging before a production run.
faq.q6: Can I combine different products in one shipment?
faq.a6: Yes. Oils, hammam products, and spa SKUs are often mixed in one export. We help structure cartons around your catalog plan.
faq.q7: Who do you supply, and from where?
faq.a7: We supply distributors, spas, hotels, and beauty brands from our Marrakesh factory in the Sidi Ghanem industrial zone.
faq.q8: How long does production and export take?
faq.a8: Lead time depends on SKU, packaging, and label approval. Share your launch date so we can propose a realistic production and shipping schedule.
faq.q9: What quality standards do you follow?
faq.a9: Manufacturing is oriented to ISO certification and GMP processes for consistent, export-ready Moroccan cosmetics.
faq.q10: How do I request a catalog and wholesale quote?
faq.a10: Use the catalog form or WhatsApp on this site. Include products, quantities, packaging, and destination for a tailored quotation.
